faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Velar P400e use?
faqLeft.a: The Velar P400e uses the 2.0-litre Ingenium AJ200P four-cylinder petrol engine, paired with an electric motor to create its plug-in hybrid (PHEV) powertrain.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Velar P400e engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Velar P400e?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine and powertrain spec.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ200P Velar P400e engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We rebuild the 2.0-litre petrol engine that forms the internal combustion part of the P400e's plug-in hybrid system.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Velar P400e engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Velar P400e if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Velar P400e engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Velar P400e owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
